title: stainless wine goblet
text: stainless wine goblet. i purchased this as a gift... it was well received.  A pretty turquoise color, the print is black and clear.  You can put cold or hot liquids inside.  Can be dishwasher cleaned - but I probably would hand wash if it were mine.
